title: 第1章 归来第2章 两年前第3章 算账
content_zh:
宇宙历年
蓝星大陆
“蓝星源晶这下是彻底平稳了，可算不会再有人来犯了，是时候该回九天神国了。再见了，朋友们。”在星空中，一位少年抚摸着胸口远远地眺望一颗蓝色的星球，随后随手一挥，空间碎裂，进入其中，消失于星空之中。
......
战铠大陆九天神国
在一间富丽堂皇的宫殿内，一位少女缓步来到了王位前，“父王。”少女向王位上的中年男子行礼。
“来了？今天是蓝星大陆上九天神国之人全部回来的日子，意味着主神们派遣给我国的使命已经结束了。
你作为九天神国的公主，理当去迎接他们回来。”这位中年男子便是九天神国的国君——姚晨昏。
“好的父亲，我会跟弟弟星耀一起去的。”少女应道。
这里是万宇宙三层位面的战铠大陆的九天神国，30年前，九天神国之人遵循主神的旨意前往一层位面的蓝星大陆守护蓝星源晶，蓝星的本源之力，不知为何，纵观万宇宙所有大陆，只有蓝星大陆才融合本源源晶。
一颗大陆的本源源晶蕴含的能量巨大，自然有许多人觊觎本源之力，若无法融合，则会使蓝星瞬间毁灭，故宇宙主神令战铠大陆之人前往阻止夺取之人，守护蓝星大陆。
这30年来，九天神国的强者陨落无数，实力下跌严重，出现青黄不接的现象，而且在战铠大陆早已是众矢之的，可仍无人敢来犯，只因九天神国有五位天赐之名的帝君。
万宇宙有三千大陆，分为一层、二层、三层，三个位面，三层位面是为最高级，三千大陆分布于二层与三层位面，而一层位面唯有蓝星大陆，且只有蓝星大陆无法修炼。
每个大陆上的人都有不同的能力，比如战铠大陆之人会觉醒战铠。
......
九天神国天星塔
天星塔作为九天神国之人前往不同大陆的通道，此时早已聚满了不少人。几天前，长者决定召回在蓝星大陆上所有的九天神国之人，蓝星大陆的本源之力已于俩年前融合完毕，现局势已平稳。于是于今日，归来。在外围都是他们的亲属，准备接他们回归家族。
就在这时，天空中毫无征兆的碎裂了一个口子，从里面散发出淡淡的暗黑气息，透露着一股死意。众人都往天上望去，神情有些畏惧。
“那是谁？一个少年？”
“不会是什么人入侵我们九天神国吧？”

“想啥呢，只要那五位大人还有一位在，就没有人胆敢来入侵我们！”
“来者何人？”声音从天星塔中传出，是天星护卫队，天星塔的守卫队。
从裂口中缓缓出现一个长着黑色羽翼的少年，少年神情有些阴郁，好似在故作深沉，眼神扫视了一圈，“九天神国，我邪帝回来了。”随后扇动翅膀，身后的裂口顷刻间重合。
“原来是邪帝大人。”天星护卫队看见少年的模样松了一口气。
“你在装什么？你还真怕别人不知道你回来了啊，赶紧滚，别把别人吓着！”传来一声既空灵悦耳又凶狠的声音，众人寻声望去，只见四匹飞马拉着马车从空中驶来。
“知道了知道了，我马上滚。炎君，跟爸妈说一声，我午饭会回来吃的。我先去黑市了。”邪帝说罢，在众人注视下挥动翅膀向东面飞去。
马车内，俩男俩女，“好的哥哥。”其中一位男子说道，这就是炎君。
“邪帝大哥回来了，九天神国估计马上又要被他整翻天咯，哈哈哈哈哈。”一位长发及腰，拥有绝世容颜的女子一笑倾城，她叫女帝。
“这家伙明明可以出现在其他地方，偏偏出现在这，装什么啊？”之前的少女还在吐槽，她便是九天神国的大公主圣君。
“可能邪帝大哥喜欢吧。”坐在圣君旁边的是九天神国的二王子姚星耀
马车缓缓落地，四人一起下车。所有人的目光都向那边看去，炎君女帝直接消失不见，圣君走在最前面，姚星耀跟在一边，空灵悦耳之声再度响起：“大家好，我是九天神国公主圣君，来此欢迎大家回家！”
......
“天项，好久不见啊。”
content_en:
cosmic calendar years
Blue Star Continent
"The Blue Star Source Crystal is completely stable now. No one will attack again. It's time to return to the Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom. Goodbye, friends." In the starry sky, a young man stroked his chest and looked at a blue planet from a distance. Then with a wave of his hand, the space shattered, entered it, and disappeared into the starry sky.
...
War Armor Continent Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom
In a magnificent palace, a girl slowly came to the throne and said, "Father." The girl saluted the middle-aged man on the throne.
"Coming? Today is the day when all the people from the Nine Heavens Kingdom on the Blue Star Continent come back, which means that the mission sent by the Lord Gods to our country has ended.
As the princess of the Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom, you should welcome them back. "This middle-aged man is the king of the Nine Heavens Kingdom - Yao Chenhun.
"Okay father, I will go with my brother Xingyao." The girl responded.
This is the Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom on the War Armor Continent in the third plane of the universe. Thirty years ago, the people of the Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom followed the will of the Lord God and went to the Blue Star Continent on the first plane to protect the Blue Star Source Crystal. The original power of Blue Star. For some reason, looking at all the continents in the universe, only the Blue Star Continent has integrated the original source crystal.
The energy contained in a continent's original source crystal is huge. Naturally, many people covet the power of the source. If it cannot be fused, Blue Star will be destroyed instantly. Therefore, the Lord God of the Universe ordered the people from the Armor Continent to stop those who seize it and protect the Blue Star Continent.
In the past 30 years, the Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom has lost countless strong men, its strength has declined seriously, and there has been a phenomenon of insufficiency. Moreover, it has long been the target of public criticism in the War Armor Continent, but no one dares to attack it, just because the Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom has five emperors with the name of God.
There are three thousand continents in the universe, divided into first, second and third levels, three planes. The third plane is the highest level. The three thousand continents are distributed in the second and third planes. The first plane only has the Blue Star Continent, and only the Blue Star Continent cannot be cultivated.
People on each continent have different abilities. For example, people on the War Armor Continent will awaken the War Armor.
...
Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom Star Tower
The Star Tower serves as a passage for people from the Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom to travel to different continents, and it is already filled with many people. A few days ago, the elder decided to recall all the people from the Nine Heavens Kingdom on the Blue Star Continent. The original power of the Blue Star Continent was integrated two years ago, and the situation is now stable. So today, I came back. On the periphery are their relatives, ready to take them back to the family.
At this moment, a hole opened in the sky without any warning, and a faint dark aura emanated from it, revealing a sense of death. Everyone looked up to the sky, looking a little scared.
"Who is that? A boy?"
"Isn't it someone who invaded our Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom?"
"What are you thinking about? As long as one of those five adults is here, no one will dare to invade us!"
"Who is coming?" The voice came from the Star Tower. It was the Star Guards, the guard team of the Star Tower.
A young man with black wings slowly appeared from the crack. The young man's expression was a little gloomy, as if he was pretending to be serious. His eyes glanced around, "Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom, my evil emperor is back." Then he flapped his wings, and the crack behind him instantly closed.
"It turns out to be the Evil Emperor." The Star Guards breathed a sigh of relief when they saw the young man's appearance.
"What are you pretending to be? Are you really afraid that others won't know you're back? Get out of here and don't scare others!" A voice that was both ethereal and melodious and fierce came. Everyone looked for the sound and saw four flying horses pulling a carriage from the sky.
"I know, I know, I'll get out of here right away. Lord Yan, tell your parents that I'll be back for lunch. I'm going to the black market first." After that, the Evil Emperor waved his wings and flew eastward under the gaze of everyone.
In the carriage, there were two men and two women, "Okay brother." One of the men said, this is Yan Jun.
"Evil EmperorThe eldest brother is back, and the Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom is probably going to be shaken up by him again soon, hahahahaha. "A woman with long hair reaching her waist and a peerless appearance is alluring with her smile. Her name is Empress.
"This guy can obviously appear elsewhere, but he appears here, what is he pretending to be? "The girl from before was still complaining. She is the eldest princess of the Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom.
"Maybe Brother Evil Emperor likes it. "Sitting next to the Holy Lord is Yao Xingyao, the second prince of the Nine Heavens Kingdom.
The carriage landed slowly and the four of them got off together. Everyone looked over there, and Empress Yanjun disappeared directly. Shengjun walked in the front, followed by Yao Xingyao. The ethereal and sweet voice sounded again: "Hello everyone, I am Shengjun, Princess of the Nine Heavens Kingdom, and I am here to welcome you home! "
...
"Tianxiang, long time no see. "
